game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before rogue crows exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before rogue crows exploit the gap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the granary door using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The granary door reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the granary door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The granary door reached with actions_used <= 11.
